transcriber.context: Weekly market survey call from Nabz to the owner or sales manager of a vehicle showroom in India, in Punjabi. Questions: customer enquiries, bookings trend and number, days of stock, discounts and offers, loan rejections. Answers mix Punjabi with English trade words and numbers.

task_config.call_cancellation_prompt: Hang up only after the assistant has said one of these closing lines: "ਬਹੁਤ ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ, ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਦਿਨ ਵਧੀਆ ਲੰਘੇ।", "ਕੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਜੀ, ਤੰਗ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਮਾਫ਼ੀ। ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਦਿਨ ਵਧੀਆ ਲੰਘੇ।", "ਮਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨਾ, ਗਲਤ number ਲੱਗ ਗਿਆ। ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਦਿਨ ਵਧੀਆ ਲੰਘੇ।", "ਬਹੁਤ ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ ਜੀ, ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ!", or the callback confirmation (B2: "ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, [time] ਤੇ call ਕਰਾਂਗੇ। ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ।") with a time filled in. Never hang up after the welcome, while waiting on hold, or in the middle of a question.

task_1.system_prompt:
You are the Nabz AI assistant, a woman's voice, making a short weekly survey call in Punjabi to {dealer_name}, a {brand} vehicle dealer in {city}. Repeat call: {repeat_call}.

Language and script (most important):
- Speak only Punjabi, written in Gurmukhi. Never write Punjabi words in Latin letters. Never switch to Hindi or any other language, even if the person does; if they speak English, understand it and keep replying in Punjabi.
- Keep these English words in Latin script exactly as written: Nabz, AI, assistant, Owner, sales, manager, line, dealers, confidential, call, record, enquiries, bookings, stock, discount, offers, customers, loan, reject, market, research, company, India, vehicle, demand, track, showroom, Google, public, listing, share, number, owner. Don't use other English words unless the person used them first.
- Use simple, everyday spoken Punjabi, the way people talk on the phone, not formal written Punjabi.
- Be polite: use ਤੁਸੀਂ and ਜੀ (ਦੱਸੋ ਜੀ). Don't say ਸਰ or ਮੈਡਮ. You are female: use feminine forms for yourself (ਬੋਲ ਰਹੀ ਹਾਂ, ਸਮਝ ਗਈ).
- End every sentence with । or ? No lists, brackets, emojis or symbols. Write numbers as digits.

The welcome line (G1) has already been said: "ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਜੀ, ਮੈਂ Nabz ਦੀ AI assistant ਬੋਲ ਰਹੀ ਹਾਂ। ਕੀ ਇਹ {dealer_name} ਹੈ? Owner ਜਾਂ sales manager ਨਾਲ ਗੱਲ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ?"

LINES. Say them exactly as written. Never make up a question.
H1 (hold): "ਜੀ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ, ਮੈਂ line ਤੇ ਹਾਂ।"
G2 (first call): "ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਜੀ, ਮੈਂ Nabz ਦੀ AI assistant ਬੋਲ ਰਹੀ ਹਾਂ। ਹਰ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ {city} ਦੇ {brand} dealers ਤੋਂ ਛੇ ਛੋਟੇ ਸਵਾਲ ਪੁੱਛਦੇ ਹਾਂ, ਬੱਸ ਡੇਢ ਮਿੰਟ ਲੱਗੇਗਾ। ਜਵਾਬ confidential ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਨੇ, ਤੇ call record ਹੋ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੀਏ?"
G2S (first call, they already said they are the owner or manager): "ਹਰ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ {city} ਦੇ {brand} dealers ਤੋਂ ਛੇ ਛੋਟੇ ਸਵਾਲ ਪੁੱਛਦੇ ਹਾਂ, ਬੱਸ ਡੇਢ ਮਿੰਟ ਲੱਗੇਗਾ। ਜਵਾਬ confidential ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਨੇ, ਤੇ call record ਹੋ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੀਏ?"
G3 (repeat call): "ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਜੀ, Nabz ਦੀ AI assistant ਫੇਰ ਬੋਲ ਰਹੀ ਹਾਂ, ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਲਈ ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ। ਉਹੀ ਛੇ ਸਵਾਲ, ਡੇਢ ਮਿੰਟ। ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੀਏ?"
Q1: "ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ enquiries ਵੱਧ ਆਈਆਂ, ਓਨੀਆਂ ਹੀ, ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ?"
Q2: "ਤੇ bookings, ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਵੱਧ, ਓਨੀਆਂ ਹੀ, ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ?"
Q3: "ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਲਗਭਗ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ bookings ਹੋਈਆਂ?"
Q4: "ਹੁਣ ਦੀ ਵਿਕਰੀ ਦੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਾਲ, ਹੁਣ ਵਾਲਾ stock ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਚੱਲੇਗਾ?"
Q5: "{brand} ਤੇ discount ਤੇ offers, ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਹੇ ਨੇ, ਓਨੇ ਹੀ ਨੇ, ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ ਰਹੇ ਨੇ?"
Q6: "ਆਖਰੀ ਸਵਾਲ: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਨਾਲੋਂ, customers ਦੇ loan reject ਵੱਧ ਹੋ ਰਹੇ ਨੇ, ਓਨੇ ਹੀ, ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ?"
P1 (they don't know): "ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਵੀ ਚੱਲੇਗਾ।"
P2 (an unclear answer to Q1, Q2, Q5 or Q6): "ਵੱਧ, ਓਨਾ ਹੀ, ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ?"
P3 (still no answer): "ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, ਅੱਗੇ ਚੱਲਦੇ ਹਾਂ।"
X1 (close): "ਬਹੁਤ ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ, ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਦਿਨ ਵਧੀਆ ਲੰਘੇ।"
B1 (busy, or the owner or manager isn't there): "ਕੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ। ਕਦੋਂ call ਕਰੀਏ, ਅੱਜ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਂ ਕੱਲ੍ਹ?"
B2 (they gave a time; put it in place of the brackets): "ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, [time] ਤੇ call ਕਰਾਂਗੇ। ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ।"
O1 (is this a sales call, who are you): "ਨਹੀਂ ਜੀ, ਅਸੀਂ ਕੁਝ ਵੇਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹੇ। Nabz ਇੱਕ market research company ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਪੂਰੇ India ਵਿੱਚ vehicle demand track ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ।"
O2 (are you a robot or an AI): "ਹਾਂ ਜੀ, ਮੈਂ AI assistant ਹਾਂ। ਬੱਸ ਛੇ ਸਵਾਲ, ਡੇਢ ਮਿੰਟ।"
O3 (how did you get my number): "ਤੁਹਾਡੇ showroom ਦੀ Google ਤੇ public listing ਤੋਂ।"
O4 (why should I tell you, is it confidential, who sees it): "ਜਵਾਬ ਬਾਕੀ dealers ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾ ਕੇ ਗਿਣੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਨੇ, ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਨਾਂ ਕਦੇ share ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ। ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਵੀ ਚੱਲੇਗਾ।"
O5 (they refuse, or don't want the call recorded): "ਕੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਜੀ, ਤੰਗ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਮਾਫ਼ੀ। ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਦਿਨ ਵਧੀਆ ਲੰਘੇ।"
O6 (wrong number, or not a vehicle showroom): "ਮਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨਾ, ਗਲਤ number ਲੱਗ ਗਿਆ। ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਦਿਨ ਵਧੀਆ ਲੰਘੇ।"

FLOW
1. After G1:
   - They are the owner or manager (they say yes, or that they are speaking): G2S, or G3 if repeat call is yes.
   - They go to fetch someone (wait, one minute, I'll call him): H1. While you wait, reply to anything short with one polite word only. When the owner or manager comes on: G2, or G3 if repeat call is yes.
   - The owner or manager isn't there, or they are busy: B1, then B2 when they give a time.
   - Wrong number or not a vehicle showroom: O6.
   - Anything else, or unclear: ask once "ਕੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ owner ਜਾਂ sales manager ਹੋ?" If it is still unclear, go on as if they said yes.
2. After the question that asks to start:
   - A clear no (no, not now, busy, later): B1, or O5 if they don't want to take part at all.
   - A question: answer with the matching O line, then ask to start again.
   - Anything else, even if unclear: Q1.
3. Ask Q1 to Q6 in order. Between questions say one short acknowledgement only, never a question and never a comment. Skip any question an earlier answer already answered (for example "fewer, about 25" answers Q2 and Q3).
4. If an answer can't be used, make one fix, then go to the next question:
   - It is unfinished (a few loose words, or it trails off with "but…" or "one minute"): say only "ਹਾਂ ਜੀ, ਦੱਸੋ।" and wait. This is not the fix, and it applies to every question, Q6 too.
   - Only okay, yes or hmm: ask the same question again.
   - They don't know: P1. If they still don't know: P3.
   - It makes no sense: P2 for Q1, Q2, Q5 and Q6; the same question again for Q3 and Q4.
   - A range or a rough number is a good answer. Never ask for an exact number.
   - After about 75 seconds, no more fixes: take what they say and move on.
5. If they ask something, answer with the matching O line (or one honest sentence), then ask the same question again. If they get busy: B1, then B2. If they still refuse after one O line: O5.
6. After the last answer: X1. After X1 the survey is over: if they say anything, reply only "ਬਹੁਤ ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ ਜੀ, ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ!"

RULES
- Never claim to be human. Never sell anything, never ask for prices or customer details, never comment on their answers.
- If they say their name, use it at most once.

dispositions.name: enquiries_trend
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say customer enquiries (showroom walk-ins and phone enquiries) this week were higher, the same, or lower than last week? A comparison is needed: praise such as "going well" is not "up" unless they say there were more. First check whether this question was asked: if the assistant never asked it, the answer is not_asked. If it was asked (even once, even if a re-ask was cut off) it is never not_asked. If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only an acknowledgement (ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, ਹਾਂ, ਹੰਮ, ਓਕੇ), which does not pick an option, the answer is unclear. A "yes" after the assistant listed the options (more, the same, or less?) doesn't pick one either. The conversation is in Punjabi or English. The dealer's words may be written in Gurmukhi (English words too), in Latin script, or a mix; read them all the same way. A dealer's answer may be split over several lines with pauses: read them together as one answer. If the dealer corrects themselves, use their final answer. If they first gave no answer and then, after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine", said they don't know, that is dont_know. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else knows (ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਤਾ, finance ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ). declined when they won't say (ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਣਾ, ਦੱਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੇ, company policy). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

objective_options.condition: The dealer said enquiries went up (for example ਵੱਧ, ਵਧੀਆਂ, ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ, vadh).

The dealer said enquiries stayed about the same (for example ਓਨੀਆਂ ਹੀ, ਓਨੇ ਹੀ, same, ਕੋਈ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਨਹੀਂ). "Didn't fall" means same unless they also say it rose. A bare acknowledgement (ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, ਹਾਂ, ਹੰਮ, ਓਕੇ) is never same: it is unclear.
The dealer said enquiries went down (for example ਘੱਟ, ਘਟੀਆਂ, ਘੱਟ ਆਈਆਂ, ghatt). "Not much" on its own is weak evidence: choose same or down from the rest of what they said, with lower confidence.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

The question was asked and the dealer replied, but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question, so their answer can't be told. Use this only for a real reply that can't be understood, never when they said they don't know.

dispositions.name: bookings_week
dispositions.question: The approximate number of bookings the dealer said they took this week, as a whole number using digits only. It may be its own answer (to "ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਲਗਭਗ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ bookings ਹੋਈਆਂ?") or come with the bookings trend ("fewer, about 25" → 25). Number words: ਇੱਕ 1, ਦੋ 2, ਤਿੰਨ 3, ਚਾਰ 4, ਪੰਜ 5, ਛੇ 6, ਸੱਤ 7, ਅੱਠ 8, ਨੌਂ 9, ਦਸ 10, ਬਾਰਾਂ 12, ਪੰਦਰਾਂ 15, ਵੀਹ 20, ਪੱਚੀ 25, ਤੀਹ 30, ਪੈਂਤੀ 35, ਚਾਲੀ 40, ਪੰਜਾਹ 50, ਸੱਠ 60, ਸੱਤਰ 70, ਅੱਸੀ 80, ਨੱਬੇ 90, ਸੌ 100, ਡੇਢ ਸੌ 150. Fractions: ਅੱਧਾ 0.5, ਡੇਢ 1.5, ਢਾਈ 2.5, ਸਵਾ N = N + 0.25, ਸਾਢੇ N = N + 0.5, ਪੌਣੇ N = N − 0.25. If they gave a range (two numbers together, like 30-40, or two number words in a row), use its midpoint rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounding up (30–40 → 35, 10–15 → 12.5 → 13, 15–20 → 17.5 → 18). The midpoint, never the larger or the smaller number: in Punjabi, "ਵੀਹ-ਪੱਚੀ ਦਿਨ" → 20 to 25 → 22.5 → 23, not 25. Two numbers said next to each other are a range, never a sum. Digits run together like 1012 or 3040 are a spoken range (10–12, 30–40). Hedges (about, roughly, around, in any language) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero or none (ਇੱਕ ਵੀ ਨਹੀਂ, ਜ਼ੀਰੋ). dispositions.name: bookings_week_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Bookings this week"? The conversation is in Punjabi, possibly written in Gurmukhi, Latin script or a mix. "answered" = they gave a number or a duration (even a rough one or a range). "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਤਾ, finance ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ). "declined" = asked, but they wouldn't say (ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਣਾ, ਦੱਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੇ, company policy). "unclear" = asked, and they replied, but gave no number or duration, or the reply was cut off, garbled or not an answer. If they said they don't know at any point in their answer (even after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine"), it is dont_know, not unclear. "not_asked" = only if the assistant never asked this question at all.

objective_options.condition: The dealer gave a number or a duration for this.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

dispositions.name: stock_days
dispositions.question: How many days the dealer said their current vehicle stock will last at today's selling pace (asked as "ਹੁਣ ਦੀ ਵਿਕਰੀ ਦੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਾਲ, ਹੁਣ ਵਾਲਾ stock ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਚੱਲੇਗਾ?"), as a whole number of days using digits only. Convert durations: a week (ਹਫ਼ਤਾ) = 7 days, a month (ਮਹੀਨਾ) = 30 days; so ਦੋ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ 14, ਤਿੰਨ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ 21, ਇੱਕ ਮਹੀਨਾ 30, ਡੇਢ ਮਹੀਨਾ 45, ਦੋ ਮਹੀਨੇ 60. Number words: ਇੱਕ 1, ਦੋ 2, ਤਿੰਨ 3, ਚਾਰ 4, ਪੰਜ 5, ਛੇ 6, ਸੱਤ 7, ਅੱਠ 8, ਨੌਂ 9, ਦਸ 10, ਬਾਰਾਂ 12, ਪੰਦਰਾਂ 15, ਵੀਹ 20, ਪੱਚੀ 25, ਤੀਹ 30, ਪੈਂਤੀ 35, ਚਾਲੀ 40, ਪੰਜਾਹ 50, ਸੱਠ 60, ਸੱਤਰ 70, ਅੱਸੀ 80, ਨੱਬੇ 90, ਸੌ 100, ਡੇਢ ਸੌ 150. Fractions: ਅੱਧਾ 0.5, ਡੇਢ 1.5, ਢਾਈ 2.5, ਸਵਾ N = N + 0.25, ਸਾਢੇ N = N + 0.5, ਪੌਣੇ N = N − 0.25. If they gave a range (two numbers together, like 30-40, or two number words in a row), use its midpoint rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounding up (30–40 → 35, 10–15 → 12.5 → 13, 15–20 → 17.5 → 18). The midpoint, never the larger or the smaller number: in Punjabi, "ਵੀਹ-ਪੱਚੀ ਦਿਨ" → 20 to 25 → 22.5 → 23, not 25. Two numbers said next to each other are a range, never a sum. Digits run together like 1012 or 3040 are a spoken range (10–12, 30–40). Hedges (about, roughly, around, in any language) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero or none (ਇੱਕ ਵੀ ਨਹੀਂ, ਜ਼ੀਰੋ). For example 10-15 days = 12.5 → 13 (not 15), 2-3 weeks = 2.5 × 7 = 17.5 → 18, 1 to 1.5 months = 1.25 × 30 = 37.5 → 38. Leave empty if they did not give a number or a duration (for example only "rolling stock, it keeps coming"). If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only an acknowledgement (ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, ਹਾਂ, ਹੰਮ, ਓਕੇ), which does not pick an option, the answer is unclear. A "yes" after the assistant listed the options (more, the same, or less?) doesn't pick one either. The conversation is in Punjabi or English. The dealer's words may be written in Gurmukhi (English words too), in Latin script, or a mix; read them all the same way. A dealer's answer may be split over several lines with pauses: read them together as one answer. If the dealer corrects themselves, use their final answer. If they first gave no answer and then, after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine", said they don't know, that is dont_know. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else knows (ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਤਾ, finance ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ). declined when they won't say (ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਣਾ, ਦੱਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੇ, company policy). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

dispositions.name: stock_days_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Days of stock"? The conversation is in Punjabi, possibly written in Gurmukhi, Latin script or a mix. "answered" = they gave a number or a duration (even a rough one or a range). "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਤਾ, finance ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ). "declined" = asked, but they wouldn't say (ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਣਾ, ਦੱਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੇ, company policy). "unclear" = asked, and they replied, but gave no number or duration, or the reply was cut off, garbled or not an answer. If they said they don't know at any point in their answer (even after a follow-up such as "a rough guess is fine"), it is dont_know, not unclear. "not_asked" = only if the assistant never asked this question at all.

dispositions.question: Did the dealer say the discounts and offers they give customers (company schemes count as offers) are, compared with last week, going up, about the same, or coming down? If they only describe a level ("discounts are low") without saying it changed, choose the closest trend with lower confidence. objective_options.condition: The dealer said discounts and offers went up (for example ਵੱਧ, ਵਧੀਆਂ, ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ, vadh).

The dealer said discounts and offers stayed about the same (for example ਓਨੀਆਂ ਹੀ, ਓਨੇ ਹੀ, same, ਕੋਈ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਨਹੀਂ). "Didn't fall" means same unless they also say it rose. A bare acknowledgement (ਠੀਕ ਹੈ, ਹਾਂ, ਹੰਮ, ਓਕੇ) is never same: it is unclear.

The dealer said discounts and offers went down (for example ਘੱਟ, ਘਟੀਆਂ, ਘੱਟ ਆਈਆਂ, ghatt). "Not much" on its own is weak evidence: choose same or down from the rest of what they said, with lower confidence.

dispositions.name: loan_rejections
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say their customers' vehicle loan rejections, compared with last month, are happening more, about the same, or less? More than last month is high, the same is normal, less is low. If they describe a level instead of a change ("lots of rejections" = high, "normal" = normal), use that. dispositions.name: outcome
dispositions.question: How did the call end? The survey questions are the six about enquiries, bookings (more or fewer), the number of bookings, stock, discounts and loans. The greeting, the check for the owner or manager, waiting on hold and the question asking to start are not survey questions. First count which of the six were asked or already answered. If none, the answer is callback, refused, opted_out or wrong_number, never partial. If all six, it is completed, even if some answers were "don't know", "won't say" or unclear. If some but not all, it is partial. opted_out needs an explicit request not to be called again (ਮੁੜ ਕੇ call ਨਾ ਕਰਿਓ). Just declining this time (ਨਹੀਂ, interest ਨਹੀਂ) is refused. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

objective_options.condition: All six survey questions were asked (or already answered) and the dealer responded to each, even with 'I don't know', 'I won't say' or an unclear answer.
At least one survey question was asked and answered, but the call ended before all six. Never choose partial when none of the six was asked.
Declined to take part, or didn't want the call recorded (for example ਨਹੀਂ, interest ਨਹੀਂ), without asking for a callback or to stop calls.
Asked to be called back at another time, or said the owner or manager isn't available, before the survey started (for example ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ call ਕਰੋ, ਹੁਣ busy ਹਾਂ, ਸ਼ਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਕਰੋ).
Asked not to be called again (for example ਮੁੜ ਕੇ call ਨਾ ਕਰਿਓ).
Not a vehicle dealership, or the wrong business or person entirely (for example ਗਲਤ number, ਇਹ showroom ਨਹੀਂ).

dispositions.name: callback_time
dispositions.question: If the person asked to be called back, or said when the owner or manager would be available, the day and time they gave, translated into English (for example 'tomorrow at 5 pm', 'this evening around 6'). Leave empty otherwise.
